DeployBot: smoke-check 1805123456 | network:ok iam:ok kms:fail audit:fail | artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/terraforge/1805123456

Evan (Platform): I'll push a small rotation-script fallback (accept date-suffixed aliases via regex) and add a verification step. Patch by EOD. Temporary workaround: map their current alias in our deploy config to the expected name.

Nora (CS): Plan: Evan patch + Priya audit. If unresolved by Friday 18:00 PT mark medium renewal risk and schedule remediation call. 20m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. I'll DM TerraForge ops a brief summary and request read-only log access if needed.
